blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The two cities are connected by this highway.
exercises.why: **два города** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (город → города); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.prompt: Tom has been nominated three times.
exercises.why: **три раза** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (раз → раза); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.
**два письма** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (письмо → письма); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.prompt: I lived in Vancouver for two months.
exercises.why: **два месяца** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (месяц → месяца); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.q: У часов две ___ (стрелка): часовая и минутная.
exercises.prompt: The clock has two hands, an hour hand and a minute hand.
exercises.why: **две стрелки** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (стрелка → стрелки); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.q: Семь в четвёртой равно две ___ (тысяча) четыреста один.

exercises.why: **две тысячи** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (тысяча → тысячи); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.q: Том отнёс две ___ (коробка) в кладовую комнату.
exercises.prompt: Tom carried two boxes into the storage room.
exercises.why: **две коробки** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (коробка → коробки); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.q: Страна два ___ (десятилетие) жила под гнётом тирании.
exercises.prompt: The country bore the yoke of tyranny for two decades.
exercises.why: **два десятилетия** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (десятилетие → десятилетия); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.
**две войны** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (война → войны); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.why: **три звезды** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (звезда → звезды); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.
